name: ffuf
summary: Fast web fuzzer written in Go.
highlights: -b — Cookie data `"NAME1=VALUE1; NAME2=VALUE2"` for copy as curl functionality.
-cc — Client cert for authentication. Client key needs to be defined as well for this to work
-ck — Client key for authentication. Client certificate needs to be defined as well for this to
-ignore-body — Do not fetch the response content. (default: false)

flags.name: -H
flags.description: Header `"Name: Value"`, separated by colon. Multiple -H flags are accepted.

flags.name: -X
flags.description: HTTP method to use

flags.name: -b
flags.description: Cookie data `"NAME1=VALUE1; NAME2=VALUE2"` for copy as curl functionality.

flags.name: -cc
flags.description: Client cert for authentication. Client key needs to be defined as well for this to work

flags.name: -ck
flags.description: Client key for authentication. Client certificate needs to be defined as well for this to work

flags.name: -d
flags.description: POST data

flags.name: -http2
flags.description: Use HTTP2 protocol (default: false)

flags.name: -ignore-body
flags.description: Do not fetch the response content. (default: false)

flags.name: -r
flags.description: Follow redirects (default: false)

flags.name: -raw
flags.description: Do not encode URI (default: false)

flags.name: -recursion
flags.description: Scan recursively. Only FUZZ keyword is supported, and URL (-u) has to end in it. (default: false)

flags.name: -recursion-depth
flags.description: Maximum recursion depth. (default: 0)

flags.name: -replay-proxy
flags.description: Replay matched requests using this proxy.

flags.name: -sni
flags.description: Target TLS SNI, does not support FUZZ keyword

flags.name: -timeout
flags.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds. (default: 10)

flags.name: -u
flags.description: Target URL

flags.name: -x
flags.description: Proxy URL (SOCKS5 or HTTP). For example: http://127.0.0.1:8080 or socks5://127.0.0.1:8080

flags.name: -V
flags.description: Show version information. (default: false)

flags.name: -ac
flags.description: Automatically calibrate filtering options (default: false)

flags.name: -acc
flags.description: Custom auto-calibration string. Can be used multiple times. Implies -ac

flags.name: -ach
flags.description: Per host autocalibration (default: false)

flags.name: -ack
flags.description: Autocalibration keyword (default: FUZZ)

flags.name: -acs
flags.description: Custom auto-calibration strategies. Can be used multiple times. Implies -ac

flags.name: -c
flags.description: Colorize output. (default: false)

flags.name: -config
flags.description: Load configuration from a file

flags.name: -json
flags.description: JSON output, printing newline-delimited JSON records (default: false)

flags.name: -maxtime
flags.description: Maximum running time in seconds for entire process. (default: 0)

flags.name: -maxtime-job
flags.description: Maximum running time in seconds per job. (default: 0)

flags.name: -noninteractive
flags.description: Disable the interactive console functionality (default: false)

flags.name: -p
flags.description: Seconds of `delay` between requests, or a range of random delay. For example "0.1" or "0.1-2.0"

flags.name: -rate
flags.description: Rate of requests per second (default: 0)

flags.name: -s
flags.description: Do not print additional information (silent mode) (default: false)

flags.name: -sa
flags.description: Stop on all error cases. Implies -sf and -se. (default: false)

flags.name: -scraperfile
flags.description: Custom scraper file path

flags.name: -scrapers
flags.description: Active scraper groups (default: all)

flags.name: -se
flags.description: Stop on spurious errors (default: false)

flags.name: -search
flags.description: Search for a FFUFHASH payload from ffuf history

flags.name: -sf
flags.description: Stop when > 95% of responses return 403 Forbidden (default: false)

flags.name: -t
flags.description: Number of concurrent threads. (default: 40)

flags.name: -v
flags.description: Verbose output, printing full URL and redirect location (if any) with the results. (default: false)

flags.name: -mc
flags.description: Match HTTP status codes, or "all" for everything. (default: 200-299,301,302,307,401,403,405,500)

flags.name: -ml
flags.description: Match amount of lines in response

flags.name: -mmode
flags.description: Matcher set operator. Either of: and, or (default: or)

flags.name: -mr
flags.description: Match regexp

flags.name: -ms
flags.description: Match HTTP response size

flags.name: -mt
flags.description: Match how many milliseconds to the first response byte, either greater or less than. EG: >100 or <100

flags.name: -mw
flags.description: Match amount of words in response

flags.name: -fc
flags.description: Filter HTTP status codes from response. Comma separated list of codes and ranges

flags.name: -fl
flags.description: Filter by amount of lines in response. Comma separated list of line counts and ranges

flags.name: -fmode
flags.description: Filter set operator. Either of: and, or (default: or)

flags.name: -fr
flags.description: Filter regexp

flags.name: -fs
flags.description: Filter HTTP response size. Comma separated list of sizes and ranges

flags.name: -ft
flags.description: Filter by number of milliseconds to the first response byte, either greater or less than. EG: >100 or <100

flags.name: -fw
flags.description: Filter by amount of words in response. Comma separated list of word counts and ranges

flags.name: -D
flags.description: DirSearch wordlist compatibility mode. Used in conjunction with -e flag. (default: false)

flags.name: -e
flags.description: Comma separated list of extensions. Extends FUZZ keyword.

flags.name: -enc
flags.description: Encoders for keywords, eg. 'FUZZ:urlencode b64encode'

flags.name: -ic
flags.description: Ignore wordlist comments (default: false)

flags.name: -input-cmd
flags.description: Command producing the input. --input-num is required when using this input method. Overrides -w.

flags.name: -input-num
flags.description: Number of inputs to test. Used in conjunction with --input-cmd. (default: 100)

flags.name: -input-shell
flags.description: Shell to be used for running command

flags.name: -mode
flags.description: Multi-wordlist operation mode. Available modes: clusterbomb, pitchfork, sniper (default: clusterbomb)

flags.name: -request
flags.description: File containing the raw http request

flags.name: -request-proto
flags.description: Protocol to use along with raw request (default: https)

flags.name: -w
flags.description: Wordlist file path and (optional) keyword separated by colon. eg. '/path/to/wordlist:KEYWORD'

flags.name: -audit-log
flags.description: Write audit log containing all requests, responses and config

flags.name: -debug-log
flags.description: Write all of the internal logging to the specified file.

flags.name: -o
flags.description: Write output to file

flags.name: -od
flags.description: Directory path to store matched results to.

flags.name: -of
flags.description: Output file format. Available formats: json, ejson, html, md, csv, ecsv (or, 'all' for all formats) (default: json)

flags.name: -or
flags.description: Don't create the output file if we don't have results (default: false)

examples.explanation: Enumerate directories using [c]olored output and a [w]ordlist specifying a target [u]RL
Enumerate webservers of subdomains by changing the position of the keyword
Fuzz with specified [t]hreads (default: 40) and pro[x]ying the traffic and save [o]utput to a file
Fuzz a specific [H]eader ("Name: Value") and [m]atch HTTP status [c]odes
Fuzz with specified HTTP method and [d]ata, while [f]iltering out specific status [c]odes and response [s]ize
Fuzz multiple positions with multiple wordlists using different modes and [a]uto [c]alibration to reduce false positives
Proxy requests through an HTTP MITM pro[x]y (such as Burp Suite or `mitmproxy`)
